# Logo Maker

Logo maker: design logo concepts from your brand name, business, style and colors. Up to four options per run, generated as image files you can download.

## What it does
Give the brand name, what the business does, a style (minimal, emblem, mascot, wordmark...) and colors. Claude prepares the brief, tells you the price, and creates up to four concepts per run in your account.

**How the files are made:** The files are generated by image, video and audio models that MegaScenes runs through its model providers. Nothing is made until you ask, and the price in credits is shown first.

Outputs are raster images (PNG). Check a logo's availability as a trademark before using it.

## Install
In Claude Code:
```
/plugin marketplace add megascenes-app/claude-plugins
/plugin install logo-maker@megascenes
```

## Setup
The plugin connects Claude to the MegaScenes MCP server at `https://megascenes.com/api/claude/logo/mcp` (Streamable HTTP).
- Connecting asks you to sign in to MegaScenes (OAuth with PKCE); you can create an account on the same page, and you come straight back to the chat.
- Creating uses the credits on your MegaScenes account, and the price is shown before anything runs. New accounts can start with a low-cost trial week.
- Where Claude supports interactive apps, results appear in a live viewer; in Claude Code you get the links.

## Tools
| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `list_logo_models` | Models for logos with settings and starting prices. Read-only. |
| `estimate_logo_cost` | Exact price of one logo before it runs. Read-only. |
| `create_logo` | Starts one logo in your account. Uses credits; needs sign-in. |
| `get_logo` | Status and file links. Read-only. |
| `get_account` | Your plan and credit balance. Read-only. |

## Example prompts
- "A minimal logo for Northwind Coffee, a specialty roaster, navy and cream"
- "Mascot logo for a kids' coding school called Byte Club"
- "Three emblem concepts for a craft brewery named Old Anchor"

## Data and privacy
Your prompts, settings and the files you choose are sent to MegaScenes and kept in your MegaScenes account, and they are sent to the model provider that makes the file. The plugin has no hooks or local scripts and sends nothing else.
- Privacy policy: https://megascenes.com/legal/privacy
- Terms of service: https://megascenes.com/legal/terms
- Documentation: https://megascenes.com/connectors#claude
